title: A discrete-time overdetermined problem for the heat equation
summary: In this paper, we consider a parabolic counterpart of Serrin's overdetermined problem, in which the overdetermined condition (constant flux condition) is imposed only on a discrete infinite set of time values. We show that, under suitable regularity assumptions on the domain, such a discrete-time overdetermined problem admits a solution if and only if the domain is a ball. Remarkably, depending on the temporal scale, the same overdetermined condition captures either geometric or spectral information, yet both mechanisms lead to the same rigidity conclusion.
